changelog:
WHAT'S NEW
Alerts reach the Player: an alert placed on Vibez, Dreamstreams or Plex now pops up in the Player too, for anyone signed into that service.
Plex: the side menu folds away while you browse and comes back with Left or Back, with the cursor on the section you were in.

FIXES
Android boxes: the Plex menu no longer shows as blank white bars.
Live TV: only one thing is highlighted at a time — the category list no longer lights up while the remote is on the left menu.
After sign-in, the finish-your-account card takes the remote instead of the screen behind it.
A box whose Android System WebView is too old for the app now says so, with the version it found and how to update it, instead of a white screen.
releaseNotes: Version 1.7.5 brings service alerts into the Player, folds the Plex menu away while you browse, and fixes the blank Plex menu on Android boxes, the double highlight in Live TV and the sign-in card that ignored the remote. Installs normally over 1.7.4.
